text: Dmitri Kowalski builds real Automated Test Framework coverage for the warranty claims workflow -- before it goes anywhere near production.
Three tests: a partner creates a claim, Flow Designer routes it, and the portal shows a partner only their own claims.
Each test impersonates a real partner test user and drives the actual portal form and list view, not a shortcut.
All three pass clean, and the suite gets scheduled to run automatically on every future change.
Next: running the same workflow through a full pre-launch UAT with real partner companies.
